# `kll_sketch_agg_bigint`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
kll_sketch_agg_bigint(expr[, k])
```

Returns the KllLongsSketch compact binary representation.
The optional k parameter controls the size and accuracy of the sketch (default 200, range 8-65535).
Larger k values provide more accurate quantile estimates but result in larger, slower sketches.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT LENGTH(kll_sketch_to_string_bigint(kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col))) > 0 FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) tab(col);
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT LENGTH(kll_sketch_to_string_bigint(kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col, 400))) > 0 FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) tab(col);
```

Result:

```text
true
```
